Completed the critic review and saved the required outputs. The same native Goal was activated once, passed the binding guard, and was completed. **I finished at 01:03:11 UTC, 5m12s after the assigned stage deadline of 00:57:59.136 UTC.** The Goal reports 16m57s elapsed.

The critique finds no material wrong assertion, but flags two material gaps: the GStreamer advisory describes a separate channel-reordering issue whose local-file reachability is unresolved, and the restart proposal lacks a defined crash-recovery protocol. The official download page also lists some 1.28.7 platform packages while 1.28.8 is the stable release, so the shipped bundle needs verification. ([GStreamer advisory](https://gstreamer.freedesktop.org/security/sa-2026-0088.html), [download page](https://gstreamer.freedesktop.org/download/), [release index](https://gstreamer.freedesktop.org/releases/))
